summary: fractal-ui restores the previous-message action beside Send, and fractal-web recalls the user's own confirmed submitted drafts

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: packages/fractal-ui gains optional EmbraceComposer showHistory/history props; hosts that omit them see no change. fractal-web keeps up to 100 confirmed submitted drafts per conversation in browser storage under a new composer.history key; no protocol, harness or CLI change.
